question: Where can I find a garden within 170 kilometers along the northeast direction from Rockford Career College, Rockford, IL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rockford Career College%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT poi_name AS name FROM pois, start_point WHERE pois.leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, start_point.geom::geography, 170000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geom, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name FROM parks, start_point WHERE parks.leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(parks.geometry::geography, start_point.geom::geography, 170000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geom, parks.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
